game.name: Project Sylpheed (Japan)
game.desc: Project Sylpheed is a shoot'em up for Xbox 360. As Katana, one of the best pilots in the Terran fleet, you are quickly confronted with your best friend, Margras, also an exceptional space warrior, who joined the rebels after his planet was destroyed by the Terran steamroller. This is followed by numerous missions and battles in space, as well as several side missions.
